errors.evidence:
Based on reliable published figures:
1. The largest county seat by land area is Seattle (King County). According to the 2020 Census, Seattle’s population was 737,015.
2. The smallest county seat by official land area turns out to be Pomeroy (Garfield County). Its 2020 Census population was 1,007.

Calculating the difference:
  Population difference = 737,015 – 1,007 = 736,008
errors.description: The assistant fabricated specific population numbers and the identification of the largest and smallest county seats without any evidence from the required data source (data.census.gov). This constitutes a hallucination of factual information.
